newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS BANK PLANS ONE MLN LITAS IN DIVIDENDS.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS BANK PLANS ONE MLN LITAS IN DIVIDENDS.

text.p: Lithuania's leading commercial bank, Vilniaus Bank, said on Monday that it would propose paying dividends of over one million litas at its shareholders' meeting on March 27.

"To meet the reporting needs of institutional investors, we will pay an average of 0.65 litas per share and the total sum we will pay in dividends is over one million litas," Julius Niedvaras, the chairman of the bank's board, said at a news conference.
The bank earlier reported that its 1996 net profit had soared to 24.4 million litas versus 2.9 million litas the previous year.
"The board decided to retain the major portion of profit for the development of the bank," Niedvaras said.
"The money will be used to upgrade the computer networks linking the bank's branch offices," he said.
